verdict.rationale: Consensus is an AI research engine and agent, so letting users plug in external MCP servers is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence only shows Consensus serving its own MCP server (mcp.consensus.app/mcp) for other agents to call. That is the server role, which does not transfer to this client-side story, and nothing documents connecting third-party MCP servers to Consensus.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
